name: Identity lifecycle and accountable ownership
fix: Disable confirmed stale access and assign an accountable owner to every machine identity; reconcile HR and directory records.

name: Privileged MFA enforcement and exceptions
fix: Enforce privileged MFA, remove unapproved exclusions and block legacy authentication; verify policy applicability, not just MFA registration.

name: Effective permissions and privilege-escalation review
fix: Remove unapproved access paths after evaluating identity, resource, trust and restricting policies together.

name: Privileged access approvals and temporary elevation
fix: Use approved time-bound elevation and retain privileged-session and approval records.

name: Maker-checker and segregation-of-duties conflicts
fix: Separate initiating and approving permissions and retest the bank-approved business-role conflict matrix.

name: Access recertification and revocation execution
fix: Complete overdue reviews and verify rejected entitlements were actually removed.

name: Workload identity and credential hygiene
fix: Scope machine permissions, assign owners and replace overdue credentials with approved short-lived workload identities where supported.

name: Session, federation and token validation tests
fix: Validate issuer, audience, expiry and revocation using approved test identities and fixtures.

name: Managed device inventory and ownership
fix: Reconcile CMDB, endpoint management and cloud inventories and assign device owners.

name: Endpoint detection coverage and agent health
fix: Restore healthy endpoint detection and remove unapproved exclusions on affected devices.

name: Critical patch and vulnerability remediation
fix: Remediate confirmed overdue critical vulnerabilities and patches, then rescan the same assets.

name: Host hardening and administrative access
fix: Apply the approved host baseline and remove unapproved local administrator privileges.

name: Application object, role and tenant authorization
fix: Enforce server-side object, role and tenant authorization and rerun approved negative tests.

name: Build provenance and software security gates
fix: Require verified artifact provenance and security gates and remediate overdue critical dependencies.

name: AI tool authorization and sensitive-data boundaries
fix: Constrain tool permissions and retrieval sources and retest disclosure and unauthorized-action cases.

name: AI validation, drift and human escalation
fix: Complete independent validation, address material drift and verify human escalation with recorded tests.

name: Sensitive-data effective access and access review
fix: Remove unapproved data grants and reconcile database, cloud and application authorization paths.

name: Encryption and key-management configuration
fix: Encrypt sensitive stores and restrict cryptographic-key access under the approved key-management policy.

name: Retention, consent and erasure execution
fix: Execute overdue erasure and retention actions and correct processing that lacks an approved lawful basis.

name: Backup integrity and demonstrated restoration
fix: Repair backups and demonstrate restoration within approved recovery objectives; backup presence is insufficient.

name: Segmentation and east-west access tests
fix: Restrict unauthorized network paths and retest segmentation using approved safe connectivity tests.

name: DNS, WAF and DDoS control effectiveness
fix: Protect public services and validate DNS-change, WAF and DDoS scenarios; merely finding a WAF is insufficient.

name: Private service access and egress restrictions
fix: Restrict data services to approved paths and enforce tested egress rules.

name: Security workflow and production-change approvals
fix: Enforce production-change approvals and reconcile deployment events with approved change records.

name: Response playbook testing and human safeguards
fix: Repair failed response playbooks and enforce approval gates for destructive actions.

name: Security exception ownership and expiry
fix: Assign exception owners and remove or formally reassess expired exceptions.

name: Critical-asset and identity audit coverage
fix: Enable required audit sources and retention for critical assets and privileged identity changes.

name: Detection scenarios and identity-event correlation
fix: Repair failed detections, correlate identity and resource activity, and investigate overdue critical alerts.

name: Audit-log integrity and timestamp validation
fix: Validate retained log integrity and timestamp synchronization; enabling digest delivery alone is not verification.

name: Incident escalation and resilience exercises
fix: Exercise incident escalation and critical dependencies, and close overdue material actions.
